buildCommand: cd web && if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun install && bun run build; else npm install && npm run build; fi
installCommand: cd web && if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun install; else npm install; fi
devCommand: cd web && if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run dev; else npm run dev; fi

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://accounts.google.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.googleusercontent.com; connect-src 'self' https://accounts.google.com https://www.googleapis.com https://oauth2.googleapis.com; frame-src https://accounts.google.com; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'
